description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment for the Gaz. Ex. No. 1505/01, Homagama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying parcel numbers, land extents, ownership details, and title classifications for various land parcels. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral maps, block numbers, village names, and administrative divisions, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
